If mode=amber, choose dax. If mode=blue, choose wug. Output only the tool name.
mode=amber, priority=normal, item=planet

If mode=amber, uppercase the item value. If mode=blue, keep the item value unchanged. Output only the resulting item.
mode=amber, priority=normal, item=planet

If priority=urgent, choose -9. If priority=normal, choose -2. Output only the suffix.
mode=amber, priority=normal, item=planet

Join the supplied tool, one space, the supplied value and the supplied suffix. There must be no space between value and suffix. Output only the joined line.
tool=dax, value=PLANET, suffix=-2

Route an item using an unfamiliar two-tool protocol. Your reply must be exactly one line in the form NAME ARGUMENT, where NAME is the tool and ARGUMENT is the transformed item string. Write no other text. 
For amber mode, use tool dax and write the item string in UPPERCASE. For blue mode, use tool wug and keep the item unchanged. For urgent priority, append -9 to the transformed item; for normal priority, append -2.
mode=amber, priority=normal, item=planet

blue | wug | unchanged
priority | suffix
normal | -2
